import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()/'tools'))
import test_rom_diagnostics_demo as diagnostics
from native_program import ROOT, require, sha256

BASE = ROOT/'build/release-0.2.3'
BUNDLE = BASE/'tagged-demo'
TITLE = 'Exec816 0.2.3 (v0.2.3)'
CHECKS = {}


class ReleaseTools(diagnostics.Tools):
    def exercise(self, session):
        original = session.command

        def command(line, *args, **kwargs):
            output = original(line, *args, **kwargs)
            if line == 'VER':
                require(TITLE.encode() in output, 'Incorrect clean release identity')
                CHECKS['release_banner'] = TITLE
            if line == 'TYPE WORK:FW.TXT':
                original('FBI WORK:HELLO.BAS', b'HELLO BASIC')
                original('FB WORK:CALC.BAS', b'3.75')
                CHECKS['packaged_fastbasic_run'] = True
            return output

        session.command = command
        super().exercise(session)
        CHECKS['firmware_smoke'] = session.saved['firmware_smoke']


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--rom', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--route', choices=('atr', 'new', 'old', 'xex'), required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--name', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--assume-xlos', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    diagnostics.Tools = ReleaseTools
    if args.route == 'old':
        original_cartridge = diagnostics.cartridge

        def old_cartridge(*positional, **kwargs):
            positional = list(positional)
            positional[4:6] = ['old', True]
            return original_cartridge(*positional, **kwargs)

        diagnostics.cartridge = old_cartridge
    route = 'cart' if args.route in ('new', 'old') else args.route
    out = BASE/args.name
    record = diagnostics.run(BUNDLE, args.rom.resolve(), out, route, args.assume_xlos)
    result = record['results']
    require(CHECKS.get('release_banner') == TITLE, 'Missing physical VER check')
    require(CHECKS.get('packaged_fastbasic_run'), 'Missing integer/FP BASIC checks')
    record.update(release_banner=TITLE, packaged_fastbasic_run=True,
                  route=args.route, assumed_xlos=args.assume_xlos,
                  firmware_smoke=CHECKS['firmware_smoke'],
                  release_observer_sha256=sha256(Path(__file__)))
    (out/'release-smoke.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2)+'\n')

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path.cwd()
BASE = (ROOT/'build/release-0.2.3').resolve()
roms = dict(altirra=ROOT/'build/firmware/altirraos-816.rom',
    x248=ROOT/'build/xlos-sdx-audit/firmware/xlos-20251207/XLOS816F.ROM',
    x249=ROOT/'build/xlos-sdx-audit/firmware/xlos-20261007/XLOS816F.ROM')
cases = [('atr-altirra', 'atr', 'altirra', False),
         ('atr-248', 'atr', 'x248', False), ('atr-249', 'atr', 'x249', False),
         ('cart-altirra', 'new', 'altirra', False),
         ('cart-248', 'new', 'x248', False), ('cart-249', 'new', 'x249', False),
         ('cart-old-altirra', 'old', 'altirra', False),
         ('cart-old-249', 'old', 'x249', False),
         ('xex-altirra', 'xex', 'altirra', False),
         ('cart-assumed-xlos', 'new', 'x249', True)]


def run(case):
    name, route, rom, assumed = case
    command = [sys.executable, str(BASE/'boot_smoke.py'), '--name', name,
               '--route', route, '--rom', str(roms[rom])]
    if assumed:
        command.append('--assume-xlos')
    with (BASE/(name+'.log')).open('w') as log:
        result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(name+' failed; see '+str(BASE/(name+'.log')))
    print(name, 'passed', flush=True)
    return name


report = dict(status='running', qualification=False, cases=[], parallel_workers=3)
try:
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:
        for future in as_completed([pool.submit(run, case) for case in cases]):
            report['cases'].append(dict(name=future.result(), status='pass'))
    report['status'] = 'pass'
finally:
    (BASE/'boot-matrix.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n')

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time

BASE = (Path.cwd()/'build/release-0.2.3').resolve()
# Reuse the same case table and subprocess command, preserving every observer.
scope = {}
exec(compile((BASE/'boot_matrix.py').read_text().split('\nreport =', 1)[0],
             str(BASE/'boot_matrix.py'), 'exec'), scope)
cases, run = scope['cases'], scope['run']
parent = int(sys.argv[1])
command = subprocess.check_output(['ps', '-p', str(parent), '-o', 'command='], text=True)
assert command.rstrip().endswith('Python ../boot_matrix.py'), command
assert not any((BASE/name).exists() for name, _, _, _ in cases[3:])
# Keep the three existing cold boots running while preventing queued duplicates.
os.kill(parent, signal.SIGSTOP)
report = dict(status='running', qualification=False, cases=[],
    concurrency='Three existing ATR cold boots plus seven independent route processes',
    initial_observer='boot_matrix.py', additional_observer=Path(__file__).name)
try:
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=7) as pool:
        for future in as_completed([pool.submit(run, case) for case in cases[3:]]):
            report['cases'].append(dict(name=future.result(), status='pass'))
    deadline = time.monotonic()+900
    for name, _, _, _ in cases[:3]:
        path = BASE/name/'release-smoke.json'
        while not path.exists():
            assert time.monotonic() < deadline, 'Initial cold boot did not complete: '+name
            time.sleep(1)
        result = json.loads(path.read_text())
        assert result['status'] == 'pass', name
        report['cases'].append(dict(name=name, status='pass'))
        print(name, 'passed', flush=True)
    assert len(report['cases']) == 10
    report['status'] = 'pass'
    # All initial observers finished; their frozen parent has no remaining work.
    os.kill(parent, signal.SIGTERM)
    os.kill(parent, signal.SIGCONT)
except BaseException:
    os.kill(parent, signal.SIGCONT)
    raise
finally:
    (BASE/'boot-matrix.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n')

import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()/'tools'))
import audit_xlos_sdx as audit
import test_sdx_runtime as component
from generate_sdx_firmware import identify
from native_program import sha256
from sdx_firmware_stack import support_bound

root=Path.cwd()
out=root/'build/release-0.2.3/firmware-matrix'
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
roms=[root/'build/firmware/altirraos-816.rom',
      root/'build/xlos-sdx-audit/firmware/xlos-20251207/XLOS816F.ROM',
      root/'build/xlos-sdx-audit/firmware/xlos-20261007/XLOS816F.ROM']
report=dict(status='running',tier='release-preparation',qualification=False,
            scope='Complete selected firmware boundary/component placement and transition matrix; full hosted-system qualification remains pending',
            pin=audit.PIN,pin_sha256=sha256(audit.PIN_PATH),roms=[],
            exclusions=['Phase 2 injects inside an owned hardware IRQ, so it is unreachable with I set. Masked cases cover phases 0, 1, 3 and 4.'])
try:
    for rom in roms:
        profile=identify(rom.read_bytes())
        case=dict(firmware=profile,native=[],component=[])
        report['roms'].append(case)
        directory=out/profile['name']
        if profile['name'].startswith('xlos-'):
            case['stack_bound']=support_bound(rom)
            for kind,flags in [(0,0xcb|width|mask) for width in (0,16,32,48) for mask in (0,4)]+[(1,0)]:
                case['native'].append(audit.native_case(rom,directory/f'native-{kind}-{flags:02x}',kind,flags))
        pin=copy.deepcopy(audit.PIN)
        pin['rom']={k:profile[k] for k in ('name','bytes','sha256')}
        component.SOURCE=root/'probes/sdx-runtime'
        component.ROM=rom
        component.PIN=pin
        component.BRIDGE=audit.BRIDGE
        component.emulator=audit.diskboot
        for bank in (2,3):
            for flags in (0xe9,0xed):
                for phase in range(5):
                    if flags & 4 and phase==2:
                        continue
                    result=component.execute(directory/f'guest-{bank}-{flags:02x}-{phase}',
                        bank,0x2200 if bank==2 else 0x2100,flags,
                        0xabcd if bank==2 else 0x1265,phase)
                    case['component'].append(result)
        print(profile['name'],len(case['native']),'native;',len(case['component']),'components passed',flush=True)
    report['status']='pass'
except Exception as error:
    report.update(status='fail',error=str(error))
    raise
finally:
    report['source_inputs']={n:sha256(root/n) for n in (
        'platform/altirraos/sdx-rom-shadow.s','platform/altirraos/sdx-firmware.json',
        'platform/altirraos/generated/sdx-firmware.inc','probes/sdx-runtime/probe.s',
        'probes/xlos-sdx/boundary.s','tools/audit_xlos_sdx.py','tools/test_sdx_runtime.py',
        'tools/sdx_firmware_stack.py')}
    report['observer_sha256']=sha256(Path(__file__))
    (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()/'tools'))
from test_sdx_resident_stack import probe
from generate_sdx_firmware import identify
from native_program import ROOT, sha256

base = ROOT/'build/release-0.2.3/resident-matrix'
previous = json.loads((base/'serial-results.json').read_text())
source = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], text=True).strip()
done = {}
for case in previous['cases']:
    key = (case['firmware']['name'], case['case'], case['name'])
    directory = base/key[0]/key[1]/key[2]
    assert case['status'] == 'pass'
    assert case['build']['exec_build']['revision'] == source
    assert not case['build']['exec_build']['dirty']
    assert sha256(directory/'program.xex') == case['build']['xex_sha256']
    assert sha256(directory/'program.a816.json') == case['build']['image_sha256']
    done[key] = case
report = dict(status='running', tier='release-preparation', qualification=False,
    cases=list(done.values()), parallel_workers=3, resumed_cases=len(done),
    serial_evidence_sha256=sha256(base/'serial-results.json'),
    serial_observer=dict(sha256=previous['observer_sha256'],
        source=(base.parent/'resident_matrix_serial.py').read_text()))
roms = [ROOT/'build/firmware/altirraos-816.rom',
        ROOT/'build/xlos-sdx-audit/firmware/xlos-20251207/XLOS816F.ROM',
        ROOT/'build/xlos-sdx-audit/firmware/xlos-20261007/XLOS816F.ROM']
groups = [('deep', 0x190, 0, 0, True, False),
          ('bounds-accepted', 0x190, 0, 0, False, False),
          ('bounds-rejected', 0x18f, 1, 0, False, False)]
groups += [(f'borrow-{p}', 0x1d0, 0, p, False, False) for p in range(1, 5)]
groups += [(f'lease-{p}', 0x1d0, 0, p, False, True) for p in range(5, 8)]


def run(rom, profile, mode, group):
    name, anchor, expected, phase, deep, lease = group
    result = probe(base/profile['name']/mode/name, mode, anchor, expected,
                   phase, deep, lease, rom)
    return dict(firmware=profile, name=name, **result)


try:
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:
        pending = []
        for rom in roms:
            profile = identify(rom.read_bytes())
            for mode in ('opt', 'raw'):
                for group in groups:
                    if (profile['name'], mode, group[0]) not in done:
                        pending.append(pool.submit(run, rom, profile, mode, group))
        for future in as_completed(pending):
            result = future.result()
            report['cases'].append(result)
            print(result['firmware']['name'], result['case'], result['name'],
                  result['checks'], 'checks;', len(report['cases']), '/ 60', flush=True)
            (base/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n')
    assert len(report['cases']) == 60
    report['status'] = 'pass'
except Exception as error:
    report.update(status='fail', error=str(error))
    raise
finally:
    report['observer_sha256'] = sha256(Path(__file__))
    (base/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n')

bundle=ROOT/'build/release-0.2.3/tagged-demo'
out=ROOT/'build/release-0.2.3/packaged-fujinet-xlos249';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
private=out/'demo';shutil.copytree(bundle,private,dirs_exist_ok=True,ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('altirra'))
with zipfile.ZipFile(bundle/'exec816-demo.zip') as z:z.extractall(out/'extracted')
extracted=out/'extracted/exec816-demo'
for line in (extracted/'SHA256SUMS').read_text().splitlines():
 wanted,name=line.split(None,1)
 require(sha256(extracted/name.strip().lstrip('*'))==wanted,'Package checksum differs')
media=out/'system.atr';shutil.copyfile(extracted/'exec816.atr',media)
firmware=Path.home()/'atari/fujinet-firmware/build/fujinet'
rom=ROOT/'build/xlos-sdx-audit/firmware/xlos-20261007/XLOS816F.ROM'

class ObservedBoot(atr.DiskBoot):
 def __call__(self,bridge,program):
  original=atr.wait_at
  entry=self.reader['reader']['disk-boot-reader.s']['labels']['reader_start']
  def observe(b,target,*args,**kwargs):
   original(b,target,*args,**kwargs)
   if target==entry:
    self.report['rom_handoff_baud']=peer.peripheral_baud
    self.report['owned_begin']=len(peer.commands)
   if target==program['labels']['loader_start']:
    self.report['owned_end']=len(peer.commands)
    self.report['native_handoff_baud']=peer.peripheral_baud
  atr.wait_at=observe
  try:super().__call__(bridge,program)
  finally:atr.wait_at=original
  bulk=[c for c in peer.commands[self.report['owned_begin']:self.report['owned_end']]
        if c['device']==0x31 and c['command']==0x52]
  require(self.report['rom_handoff_baud']==57600,'ROM did not exercise fast handoff')
  require(self.report['native_handoff_baud']==57600,'Native handoff speed changed')
  require(bulk and all(c['host_baud']==c['peripheral_baud']==57600 and not c['rate_mismatch'] for c in bulk),
          'Owned bulk transfer fell back to standard')
  self.report['owned_bulk_reads']=len(bulk)
  self.report['owned_bulk_baud']=57600
  print('Owned speed checked:',len(bulk),'reads at 57600',flush=True)

boot=ObservedBoot(private,peer=True)
with FujiNetPC(out/'peer',media,firmware,hsio_index=8) as peer:
 result=run(private,boot_smoke=True,bootstrap=boot,media_path=media,rom_override=rom,
            integration=Tools(),distribution_root=extracted,sio_peer=peer,emulator_output=out/'emulator',boot_verbose=True)
 require(peer.error is None,str(peer.error))
require(CHECKS.get('release_banner')=='Exec816 0.2.3 (v0.2.3)' and CHECKS.get('packaged_fastbasic_run'),'Missing release checks')
record=dict(release_checks=CHECKS,status='pass',tier='development',qualification=False,zip_sha256=sha256(bundle/'exec816-demo.zip'),
 rom_sha256=sha256(rom),firmware_sha256=sha256(firmware),observer_sha256=sha256(Path(__file__)),
 boot=boot.report,results=result,relay=json.loads((out/'peer/relay.json').read_text()))
(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Packaged XLOS/FujiNet boot, tools, WORK and EXIT passed',flush=True)

    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def load(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text())


def record(name, value):
    (BASE/name).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2)+'\n')


assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], text=True).strip()
ASSETS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
shutil.copyfile(BUNDLE/'exec816-demo.zip', ASSETS/'exec816-demo.zip')
for path in sorted(ASSETS.glob('*.zip')):
    path.with_suffix('.zip.sha256').write_text(sha(path)+'  '+path.name+'\n')

application_comparison = {}
previous_release = load(ROOT/'docs/development/release-0.2.2.json')
assert sha(PREVIOUS/'exec816-demo.zip') == previous_release['assets']['exec816-demo.zip']['sha256']
with zipfile.ZipFile(PREVIOUS/'exec816-demo.zip') as archive:
    previous_disk = Audit(archive.read('exec816-demo/exec816.atr'))
    previous_disk.sdfs()
current_disk = Audit((BUNDLE/'exec816.atr').read_bytes())
current_disk.sdfs()
for name in ('COUNTER.APP', 'CALC.APP', 'FILES.APP', 'G4BENCH.APP', 'TEXT.APP',
             'BASIC.APP', 'DIALOG.APP', 'PANEL.APP'):
    old = PREVIOUS/'media/C'/name
    new = BUNDLE/'media/C'/name
    assert old.read_bytes() == previous_disk.files['C/'+name]
    assert new.read_bytes() == current_disk.files['C/'+name]
    application_comparison[name] = dict(sha256=sha(new), unchanged=sha(old) == sha(new))
assert all(c['unchanged'] for c in application_comparison.values())
record('application-comparison.json', application_comparison)
old_memory = load(PREVIOUS/'build.json')['memory']
new_memory = load(BUNDLE/'build.json')['memory']
assert old_memory['bank_zero_budget'] == new_memory['bank_zero_budget']
assert old_memory['task_pools'] == new_memory['task_pools']
record('memory-comparison.json', dict(reserved_bank_zero_unchanged=True,
    previous='v0.2.2', current='v0.2.3',
    budget=new_memory['bank_zero_budget'],
    task_pools=new_memory['task_pools'],
    includes_guards_alignment_and_unused_capacity=True))
package = dict(status='pass', archives={}, previous_demo_sha256=sha(PREVIOUS/'exec816-demo.zip'))
for path in sorted(ASSETS.glob('*.zip')):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
        assert archive.testzip() is None
        prefix = 'exec816-demo/' if path.name == 'exec816-demo.zip' else ''
        checked = 0
        for row in archive.read(prefix+'SHA256SUMS').decode().splitlines():
            expected, name = row.split('  ', 1)
            assert hashlib.sha256(archive.read(prefix+name)).hexdigest() == expected, name
            checked += 1
        if prefix:
            names = set(archive.namelist())
            required = {prefix+x for x in ('Exec-of816.xex', 'exec816.atr',
                'altirraos-816.rom', 'README.txt', 'SHA256SUMS')}
            assert required <= names
            assert any(name.startswith(prefix+'licenses/') for name in names)
            assert not any('XLOS' in name or 'QED' in name.upper() or
                'manifest' in name or name.endswith('.json') for name in names)
            for name in names:
                relative = name.removeprefix(prefix)
                assert relative in ('Exec-of816.xex', 'exec816.atr', 'altirraos-816.rom',
                    'README.txt', 'SHA256SUMS') or relative.startswith(('licenses/', 'cartridge/')), relative
            disk = Audit(archive.read(prefix+'exec816.atr'))
            disk.sdfs()
            for name in ('MD5.COM', 'ARC.COM', 'EDX.COM', 'FBI.COM', 'FB.COM',
                         'FBCI.COM', 'FBC.COM', 'BASIC.APP'):
                assert 'C/'+name in disk.files, name
            assert any(name.startswith('C/') and name.endswith('.OVL') for name in disk.files)
            assert 'WORK/HELLO.BAS' in disk.files and 'WORK/CALC.BAS' in disk.files
            package['system_files'] = len(disk.files)
            assert archive.read(prefix+'altirraos-816.rom') == (ROOT/'build/firmware/altirraos-816.rom').read_bytes()
        else:
            tracked = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '-z']).decode().split('\0')
            for name in tracked:
                if name and name != 'exec816-demo.zip':
                    assert archive.read('exec816/'+name) == (ROOT/name).read_bytes(), name
        package['archives'][path.name] = dict(entries=len(archive.namelist()),
            checksummed_files=checked, bytes=path.stat().st_size, sha256=sha(path))
record('package-audit.json', package)
print(json.dumps(package, indent=2))
